**What I built:** Fixed `Features/Navigation/RootTabView.swift` — the recurring `tabBar.knownLimitsTab` (and siblings) UI-crawl failure. That's not a bug in polish_resilience's lane; it's the same disclosed camera-capture gap already on record, so I didn't fabricate a fake capture session to force a wiring point.
